cases.name: the user profile deploys into a workshop what the synchronisation deployed before lot 11 from the same tree less packs/, plus the profile definitions under .claude/harness/profiles/ (Δ = 0 for the session)
cases.cmd:
. {{FIX}}/lib.sh {{ROOT}} {{CLAUDE}} {{FIX}}/{{SID}}
need_sync; [ -d "$H/profiles/packs" ] && [ -d "$H/claude/hooks" ] || { printf 'ok (skipped: the harness tree is not here)'; exit 0; }
mkdir -p "$F/now" "$F/old" "$F/a" "$F/b" || exit 1
(cd "$H" && tar cf - --exclude=./evals/.fixtures .) | (cd "$F/now" && tar xf -) || exit 1
(cd "$H" && tar cf - --exclude=./evals/.fixtures --exclude=./packs --exclude=./profiles .) | (cd "$F/old" && tar xf -) || exit 1
HARNESS_STAGING=$F/now sy "$F/a" >/dev/null || fail 'sync of the profiles tree failed'
HARNESS_STAGING=$F/old sy "$F/b" >/dev/null || fail 'sync of the old tree failed'
d=$(diff -r -q -x '.harness-*' "$F/a" "$F/b")
[ "$d" = "Only in $F/a/.claude/harness: profiles" ] || fail "$d"
[ ! -e "$F/a/.claude/local" ] && [ ! -e "$F/a/.claude/.harness-space" ] || fail 'state written for user'
printf 'ok'

cases.name: dev in a checkout: the source and dev files are deployed into .claude/, no seed and no workshop folder, a delimited block of .git/info/exclude lists them, and git status stays clean
cases.cmd:
. {{FIX}}/lib.sh {{ROOT}} {{CLAUDE}} {{FIX}}/{{SID}}
need_sync; mkstg; r=$F/r; mkrepo "$r" https://github.com/Orkeon/orkeon.git
out=$(wp "$r" dev) || fail "$out"
printf '%s' "$out" | grep -qF '[harness] synchronised into' || fail "$out"
for f in .claude/skills/dev-probe/SKILL.md .claude/agents/dev-probe.md .claude/rules/source-space.md .claude/rules/orkeon-probe.md \
         .claude/harness/packs/repo-orkeon/references/repo.yaml .claude/settings.json .claude/hooks/probe.sh .claude/skills/workshop-profile/SKILL.md; do
  [ -f "$r/$f" ] || fail "missing $f"
done
for f in CLAUDE.md .gitignore .gitattributes teams workbooks .claude/harness/HARNESS.md .claude/skills/team-probe .claude/rules/ws-probe.md .claude/skills/docs-audit-probe; do
  [ ! -e "$r/$f" ] || fail "present: $f"
done
[ "$(. "$C/lib/team-common.sh"; harness_space "$r")" = source ] || fail 'the space the synchronisation wrote is not the one the hooks read'
[ -z "$(git -C "$r" status --porcelain)" ] || fail "git status: $(git -C "$r" status --porcelain)"
mkdir -p "$r/todo/x" && printf 's\n' > "$r/todo/x/SPEC-x.md"
[ -z "$(git -C "$r" status --porcelain)" ] || fail 'todo/ shows'
out=$(sy "$r") || fail "$out"
printf '%s' "$out" | grep -qF '[harness] up to date' || fail "second start: $out"
ex=$r/.git/info/exclude; top=$(git -C "$r" rev-parse --show-toplevel)
[ "$(grep -cxF "# >>> orkeon-workshop harness $top" "$ex")" = 1 ] && [ "$(grep -cxF "# <<< orkeon-workshop harness $top" "$ex")" = 1 ] || fail "$(cat "$ex")"
[ "$(grep -c '^# [<>]\{3\} orkeon-workshop harness' "$ex")" = 2 ] || fail "$(cat "$ex")"
grep -qx '/.claude/skills/dev-probe/SKILL.md' "$ex" && grep -qx '/todo/' "$ex" && grep -qx '/.claude/local/' "$ex" || fail "$(cat "$ex")"
printf 'ok'

cases.name: THIRD-PARTY.md is in core (D56): the resolution of dev in a checkout and of user in a workshop both keep it in the manifest, and it belongs to one pack only
cases.cmd:
. {{FIX}}/lib.sh {{ROOT}} {{CLAUDE}} {{FIX}}/{{SID}}
mkstg; put THIRD-PARTY.md; mkrepo "$F/r" https://github.com/acme/thing.git; mkdir -p "$F/r/.claude/local" && printf 'dev\n' > "$F/r/.claude/local/profile"
(cd "$STG" && find . -type f -printf '%P\n' | LC_ALL=C sort | sed 's/^/0000  /') > "$F/m"
out=$(wp "$F/r" --resolve --space source --manifest "$F/m" "$F/m.src") || fail "$out"
printf '%s' "$out" | grep -qx 'packs core source dev quality usage' || fail "$out"
grep -qx '0000  THIRD-PARTY.md' "$F/m.src" && ! grep -q '  HARNESS.md$' "$F/m.src" || fail "source: $(cat "$F/m.src")"
mkws "$F/w"; out=$(wp "$F/w" --resolve --space workshop --manifest "$F/m" "$F/m.ws") || fail "$out"
printf '%s' "$out" | grep -qx 'packs core workshop' && grep -qx '0000  THIRD-PARTY.md' "$F/m.ws" && grep -q '  HARNESS.md$' "$F/m.ws" || fail "workshop: $out $(cat "$F/m.ws")"
out=$(HARNESS_STAGING=$STG wp "$F/w" --check) || fail "$out"
printf '%s' "$out" | grep -qF 'every file belongs to exactly one pack' || fail "$out"
printf 'ok'

cases.name: a checkout git refuses as another user's (a bind mount from Windows: dubious ownership) is added to safe.directory once, with a line saying so, and then takes its profile; a dry run only says it would
cases.cmd:
. {{FIX}}/lib.sh {{ROOT}} {{CLAUDE}} {{FIX}}/{{SID}}
need_sync; mkstg; mkrepo "$F/r" https://github.com/acme/thing.git
REAL=$(command -v git) || fail 'no git'
mkdir -p "$F/bin" && cat > "$F/bin/git" <<EOS
#!/bin/bash
# A git that answers "dubious ownership" for $F/r until safe.directory names it.
r='$F/r'; m='$F/safe'
if [ "\$1" = config ] && [ "\$2" = --global ] && [ "\$3" = --add ] && [ "\$4" = safe.directory ]; then printf '%s\\n' "\$5" >> "\$m"; exit 0; fi
if [ "\$1" = -C ] && [ "\$2" = "\$r" ] && ! grep -qxF "\$r" "\$m" 2>/dev/null; then echo "fatal: detected dubious ownership in repository at '\$r'" >&2; exit 128; fi
exec '$REAL' "\$@"
EOS
chmod +x "$F/bin/git"; export PATH="$F/bin:$PATH"
out=$(sy "$F/r" --dry-run) || fail "dry: $out"
printf '%s' "$out" | grep -qF "git refuses $F/r (dubious ownership" && printf '%s' "$out" | grep -qF 'would be added to safe.directory' || fail "dry: $out"
[ ! -e "$F/safe" ] || fail 'dry run wrote safe.directory'
out=$(HARNESS_PROFILE=dev sy "$F/r") || fail "$out"
printf '%s' "$out" | grep -qF "[harness] git: $F/r is owned by another user (a bind mount): added to safe.directory for" || fail "line: $out"
[ "$(cat "$F/safe")" = "$F/r" ] || fail "safe.directory: $(cat "$F/safe" 2>&1)"
[ "$(head -n 1 "$F/r/.claude/local/profile")" = dev ] || fail "profile: $out"
printf '%s' "$out" | grep -q 'synchronised into' || fail "sync: $out"
out=$(sy "$F/r") || fail "again: $out"
printf '%s' "$out" | grep -qF 'safe.directory' && fail "said twice: $out"
[ "$(cat "$F/safe")" = "$F/r" ] || fail 'added twice'
printf 'ok'
